Package de.hallerweb.enterprise.prioritize.dto.security

Record Class UserRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
de.hallerweb.enterprise.prioritize.dto.security.UserRequest
public record UserRequest(String username, String name, String firstname, String email, String occupation, Instant dateOfBirth, PUser.Gender gender, AddressRequest address, Boolean admin, Boolean active) extends Record
Request body for creating or updating a PUser. Carries the profile base data only. It deliberately has NO password field: passwords are @JsonIgnore on the entity and never travel through the JSON API by design (a REST-created record is passwordless; login-able users are made via the admin GUI). It also omits roles, personal permissions and the department — those are managed through dedicated, elevated-authorization endpoints. admin/active are boxed so a PATCH leaves them untouched when absent.
Author:
peter haller

  • Method Details

    • toUser

      public PUser toUser()
      Builds a plain, id-less PUser carrying exactly the supplied fields. Uses the no-arg constructor and setters on purpose — NOT the Lombok builder — so the @Builder.Default values (e.g. active=true, the collection defaults) do not fill in fields the request left out. This mirrors what Jackson used to deserialize straight into the entity, keeping the create/PUT/PATCH semantics unchanged; admin/active are only applied when explicitly supplied.
